```lean
constructor
· intro h
  rw [h]
  refl
· intro h
  have h1 : a * a = (a.natAbs * a.natAbs) := by
    cases a with n
    · rw [int.natAbs_of_nonneg n]
      rw [mul_self_eq_mul_self n]
    · rw [int.natAbs_of_neg n]
      rw [mul_self_eq_mul_self (-n)]
  have h2 : b * b = (b.natAbs * b.natAbs) := by
    cases b with m
    · rw [int.natAbs_of_nonneg m]
      rw [mul_self_eq_mul_self m]
    · rw [int.natAbs_of_neg m]
      rw [mul_self_eq_mul_self (-m)]
  rw [h1, h2] at h
  exact eq.symm h
```
